agent-questions: Styles and scans the native question card. It renders no surface of its own; the card it decorates belongs to DSH core and needs a live model turn to appear.
diff-viewed: Adds a Viewed toggle to the deliverables review pane. The pane only exists for a turn that produced reviewable files, and the scratch seeds create none.
goal-stall-guard: Host-side goal policy. It renders nothing itself: the pause, continue or close it decides appears in the native goal controls.
send-after-upload: Its composer pill exists only while an attachment upload is still running. The upload is an XHR in a Web Worker that only a Playwright route can hold, and that route ends when `dshx dev open` disconnects, so no reach path can keep the pill on screen for `dshx dev shot`; the send-after-upload.queued-send journey covers it.
shared-runtime: Loads the one shared copy of the Client UI modules. It renders no surface of its own to screenshot.
shortcuts: Installs keyboard chords only. Every visible result belongs to the surface whose control the chord drives, not to this plugin.
ui-styles: Compiles and injects the shared plugin stylesheet once per page. It has no screen of its own, only the sheets other plugins render with.
settings-web-search: A whole-row fork of the stock Web search page. It replaces the stock settings row inside the Plugin Manager's Plugins panel, which the seeded scratch profile does not install, so no scratch walk can open it; the settings-shell journey 'The Web search plugin page comes from the owned fork' opens it through that panel and proves the page renders.
settings-subagent: A whole-row fork of the stock Subagent page. It replaces the stock settings row inside the Plugin Manager's Plugins panel, which the seeded scratch profile does not install, so no scratch walk can open it; the settings-shell journey 'The Subagent plugin page comes from the owned fork' opens it through that panel and proves the page renders.
cordis-cards: A whole-row fork of the stock Cordis panel and tool cards whose only delta is when the dynamic-plugin inventory is read, so its screens are stock DSH UI; the cards appear only for a dynamic Cordis package a model turn defines, which no scratch seed creates.
schedule: A whole-row fork of the stock Tasks page and Session reminders whose only delta is when a catalog rereads schedule/list; every screen it renders is the stock DSH UI, byte-identical to the pinned tag, so a capture would showcase core rather than this plugin.
